title: AI & Machine Learning Workshop
description:
Join us for a hands-on workshop exploring the latest developments in AI and machine learning. Perfect for beginners and intermediates looking to expand their knowledge.

What we'll cover:
- Introduction to neural networks
- Practical ML model building
- Real-world applications
- Q&A session with industry experts

Bring your laptop and enthusiasm!

title: Sunset Hike at Rattlesnake Ledge
description:
Experience breathtaking views on this moderate 4-mile hike. We'll start in the afternoon to catch the stunning sunset from the ledge.

Details:
- Difficulty: Moderate
- Distance: 4 miles roundtrip
- Elevation gain: 1,160 feet
- What to bring: Water, snacks, layers, headlamp

Carpooling available from Seattle!

title: Abstract Art Workshop
description:
Unleash your creativity in this beginner-friendly abstract painting workshop. All materials provided!

- Texture techniques
- Composition principles

No experience necessary - just bring an open mind!

- Diverse cuisines (Italian, Japanese, Mexican, Middle Eastern)
- Stories about neighborhood history
- Vegetarian options available

Come hungry!

title: Half Marathon Training Run
description:

- Distance: 10 miles
- Pace group_ids: 8:00, 9:00, 10:00, 11:00 min/mile
- Water stops provided
- Post-run stretching session
